subject: Before your next harness run: two NEW proofs joined validate-sim-macos.sh automatically, and the determinism declared count moved
body:
PR #297 merged as 69562bb. Four surfaces you run were touched. Nothing here needs a reply — this is so a red result on your machine reads as a real regression instead of a surprise.

1) TWO NEW PROOFS, and the harness picks them up WITHOUT you doing anything. validate-sim-macos.sh enumerates every proof:* script, so proof:itsm-credential-crypto (20 checks) and proof:telemetry-posture-cache (21 checks) join your run automatically. Both are pure and need no daemon, no network, no Xcode — they should pass on your box exactly as they do here. If either goes red on the Mac and green in CI, that is a real finding and I want it: send it back rather than working around it.

2) THE DETERMINISM DECLARED COUNT CHANGED, 22 -> 23 for lib/integrations/src/. review-invariants.mjs pins the number of clock reads per package, so if you touch anything under lib/integrations/ and add or remove a Date.now(), preflight fails with COUNT DRIFT and names the number. That is the pin working, not a broken gate. The 23rd is telemetry/store.ts getPostureForHost's default argument, and its reason is recorded in the registry entry itself.

3) check-ungated-fetch.mjs GOT STRICTER, and this one can bite a legitimate change. Scope used to be class methods only; it now also covers EXPORTED top-level functions. An exported function that reaches fetch clears only if it carries a gate token itself, or if every call site of it — in its own file or its family's index.ts — sits inside a function whose body carries one. A function with NO call site does not clear, deliberately. If you add an exported transport factory and it comes back flagged, the fix is almost always that its resolver needs the gate token, not that the gate is wrong. It also has a self-test now: node scripts/check-ungated-fetch.mjs --self-test, 12/12.

4) TWO BEHAVIOUR CHANGES under lib/integrations, both fail-closed, both latent rather than live. itsm/store.ts now derives its AES key with SHA-256 and REFUSES a secret under 32 characters instead of padding it with zeros; if you have an ITSM_ENCRYPTION_KEY set locally that is shorter than that, it will now throw where it used to silently work. telemetry/store.ts getPostureForHost now honours expiresAt and evicts what it finds expired — it previously returned in-memory entries forever.

STILL OWED FROM YOUR SIDE, unchanged and not a nag: 2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup is still pending (pnpm run sim:run-requests --id 2026-08-23-glpi-first-bringup), and there are 9 messages in your inbox from this lane, oldest first. The OPERATIONAL HAZARD one still applies and matters most before you run the full harness: a killed mutation sweep leaves planted fail-opens in your working tree.
